summary: Frontend-only fidelity sweep completed against https://pensive-goodall-6.preview.emergentagent.com using owner HTML routes (desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844). Source hash check passed for frontend/public/prototype/v2_os.html (9952692ce05809b3f4111c8ec3cf9dcb1008ea970895263981c2b52fb78cf199). Major gaps found in WorkDocuments runtime behavior and mobile estate table labeling; estate error text currently leaks backend/seam internals.

critical.issue: Error payload details are surfaced directly in UI (estate alert includes seam/internal DB error string with host/user fragments: 'PULL_SEAM_WORKER_FAILED... Access denied for user ...'). Needs server-side/edge sanitization before returning user-facing message.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error 'setSelected is not a function' when opening a document row; selected detail pane fails (blank title / missing expected download controls during row-open flow).
All checked estate table cells lack data-label (523/523 td missing), so mobile stacked rows have unlabeled values and weak readability.
Duplicate data-testid values found (e.g., estate-db-row-viutickets, estate-db-row-kra_reports, estate-db-row-viupay each repeated), violating uniqueness requirement.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend state setter mismatch prevents reliable detail rendering and controls for selected commission.

issues: Stacked table rows lack per-cell labels due to missing data-label attributes, reducing scanability on 390x844.

action_items: Fix WorkDocuments state wiring: use the hook's returned selector function instead of undefined setSelected path.
Sanitize estate-report backend error responses so sensitive internal seam/DB details are not shown in UI alerts.
Add data-label attributes to estate table td cells (or equivalent responsive labeling) for mobile stacked layouts.
Ensure generated/assigned estate row data-testid values are unique per row instance.
critical_code_review_comments: WorkDocuments.jsx destructures setSelected from useStudio(), but useStudio returns select; this mismatch aligns with runtime PAGE ERROR 'setSelected is not a function'.
EstateIntelligence renders backend error string directly; this leaks internal operational detail to end users.
Prototype fidelity anchors validated: chat header measured exactly 52px, no horizontal overflow detected on tested pages/viewport set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop + mobile screenshots captured under /app/test_reports/screenshots/iteration_74_ui (chat/documents/estate/model/rules/media/entitlement). Estate cleanup CSV download validated (Estate-cleanup-review.csv). Chat checks passed for sessionStorage keys, send-disable on empty draft, conversation rail toggle, no raw token-like IDs visible in chat text. Legacy routes /os, /os/admin/estate, /os/build/train still load unchanged shell markers.
rca of the issue: Primary frontend failure: WorkDocuments uses setSelected in choose(), but useStudio hook exposes select. Repro: sign in -> /os/work/documents -> click any row ([data-testid^='studio-select-']) -> console PAGE ERROR 'setSelected is not a function'. Result: selected document detail path is unstable/blank and expected selected-document controls are not reliably rendered. Secondary risk: estate report errors are passed through directly from backend, causing internal seam/DB failure strings to appear in user UI; mitigation is backend sanitization + frontend generic-safe message mapping.
